skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and scope of government intervention in a market economy.
Analyze the four fundamental roles of government in a market economy: resource allocation, income redistribution, macroeconomic stability, and national representation.
Evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of government policies in different economic contexts.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze real-world economic scenarios and policy interventions.
Acquire research skills to independently study and accumulate knowledge in the field of public economics.
Understand ethical and professional responsibilities in policy-making and evaluation.
Improve communication skills through class participation and discussions.
Develop self-learning and self-study habits to adapt to changing work environments.
